fusions.name: Reef Bloom
fusions.desc: Raises jagged growth around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and making them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Accretion
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.8 times their remaining damage to the hit. Its damage rises 10% per affliction on the target (max 50%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Reef Garden
fusions.desc: Raises a living reef where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Layer on Layer
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
